# Moiré interference

Overlays two fine line or ring patterns at a slight angle, so they interfere into the large, shifting bands of moiré, as in security holograms and layered screens.

<EffectDemo effect="moire" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { moire } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/moire';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(moire({ preset: 'security' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.pattern = 'lines'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Type               | Default   | Range     | Description                                                   |
| ------------------------ | ------------------ | --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pattern` _(structural)_ | 'lines' \| 'rings' | `'lines'` |           | Straight lines or concentric rings.                           |
| `frequency`              | number             | `80`      | 10 – 300  | Lines per frame height.                                       |
| `angle`                  | number             | `30`      | 0 – 180 ° | Angle of the first pattern.                                   |
| `twist`                  | number             | `3`       | 0 – 30 °  | Angle between the two patterns; small angles make wide bands. |
| `scale`                  | number             | `0.02`    | 0 – 0.2   | Difference in spacing between the patterns.                   |
| `offset`                 | number             | `0`       | 0 – 1     | Shift of the second pattern.                                  |
| `speed`                  | number             | `0.5`     | 0 – 3     | Drift of the second pattern, which moves the bands.           |
| `iridescence`            | number             | `0.5`     | 0 – 1     | Rainbow tint in the bands.                                    |
| `amount`                 | number             | `0.5`     | 0 – 1     | Strength of the pattern over the image.                       |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                                          |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `security` | `frequency: 160`, `twist: 1.5`, `iridescence: 0.8`, `amount: 0.4` |
| `rings`    | `pattern: 'rings'`, `frequency: 60`, `scale: 0.04`                |
| `silk`     | `frequency: 200`, `twist: 0.8`, `amount: 0.3`, `iridescence: 0`   |
| `screen`   | `frequency: 40`, `twist: 5`, `amount: 0.7`                        |

Apply one with `moire({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Holographic & iridescent · tracked as story X11.6 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Cost:** 5.1 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 5.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/moire`, including the shared effect runtime.
